posts.name: Tamar
posts.cooked:
Because I love sharing pictures and seeing pics of what costumes and cool things other people do!

Darth Princess! She even had a sparkly light pink skirt. She was fantastic and adorable and kind of makes me want to do a big kid version of this. Because I’m a huge nerd. Belated Gen Con pics time! How cute is Darth Princess?  Pics of my head when I’m in the Tachyon get up make me really wish I’d gotten my red paint for my HUD goggles in time. Argh!

Captain Jack Sparrow Jr. I have a thing for little kids in costume (clearly) so when I saw this girl and the boy in the next pic hanging out together I had to get pics with both. The Adorablest Jack Sparrow you've ever seen. She was great!
I look way to happy about the fact that I’m about to be assassinated. And Captain Jack was hanging out with the tiniest assassin:

There was also an adorable girl in a Dalek dress, but I didn’t get any pics of her. Dalek inspired dress has been on my list since I first saw one a while ago and I think I need to get on that, but I just haven’t been in a designing mood lately. Curse you, children who are better costumed than I am!

Seriously my friends need to start breeding so I can dress their children up in ridiculous costumes. I can only make myself so many.

So what pics of costumes or general fun and hanging out and coolness did other people get?
